_about: Public-domain Howard Crosby (1826-1891), Presbyterian minister of the Fourth Avenue Church, New York, Chancellor of New York University and a New Testament reviser, for the Word Hoard: Lands of the Moslem (1851), The New Testament with Brief Explanatory Notes or Scholia (1863), The Healthy Christian (1871), Jesus: his Life and Work (1871), Thoughts on the Decalogue (1873), The Bible on the Side of Science (1875), Expository Notes on Joshua (1875), The Book of Nehemiah (1877), The Christian Preacher (Yale lectures, 1879) and The True Humanity of Christ (1880). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 62 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

crosby-lands-of-moslem: Lands of the Moslem : a narrative of oriental travel (New York : Carter and Brothers, 1851)

_excluded.crosby-other: His school edition of Sophocles' Oedipus Tyrannus (1858); Moderation vs. Total Abstinence (1881, his address bound with his reviewers' replies); Fanny Crosby and other Crosbys
